glossary.definition: (a) "Civil Rights" has the same meaning as in section 5122.301 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.51 - Mental health professional or organization not liable for violent behavior by client or patient.

glossary.definition: (b) "Mental health client or patient" means an individual who is receiving mental health services from a mental health professional or organization.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.51 - Mental health professional or organization not liable for violent behavior by client or patient.

glossary.definition: (c) "Mental health organization" means an organization that engages one or more mental health professionals to provide mental health services to one or more mental health clients or patients.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.51 - Mental health professional or organization not liable for violent behavior by client or patient.

glossary.definition: (d) "Mental health professional" means an individual who is licensed, certified, or registered under the Revised Code, or otherwise authorized in this state, to provide mental health services for compensation, remuneration, or other personal gain.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.51 - Mental health professional or organization not liable for violent behavior by client or patient.
Section 2305.51 - Mental health professional or organization not liable for violent behavior by client or patient.

glossary.definition: (f) "Knowledgeable person" means an individual who has reason to believe that a mental health client or patient has the intent and ability to carry out an explicit threat of inflicting imminent and serious physical harm to or causing the death of a clearly identifiable potential victim or victims and who is either an immediate family member of the client or patient or an individual who otherwise personally knows the client or patient.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.51 - Mental health professional or organization not liable for violent behavior by client or patient.

glossary.definition: (g) "Advanced practice registered nurse" has the same meaning as in section 4723.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.51 - Mental health professional or organization not liable for violent behavior by client or patient.

glossary.definition: (h) "Hospital" has the same meaning as in section 2305.25 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.51 - Mental health professional or organization not liable for violent behavior by client or patient.

glossary.definition: (i) "Physician" means an individual authorized under Chapter 4731. of the Revised Code to practice medicine and surgery or osteopathic medicine and surgery.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.51 - Mental health professional or organization not liable for violent behavior by client or patient.

glossary.definition: (j) "Physician assistant" has the same meaning as in section 4730.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.51 - Mental health professional or organization not liable for violent behavior by client or patient.

glossary.definition: (k) "Certified mental health assistant" has the same meaning as in section 4772.01 of the Revised Code.
glossary.source_title: Section 2305.51 - Mental health professional or organization not liable for violent behavior by client or patient.
